item.title: You Can Put M&M's in a Pepper Grinder?!
item.description: Who says pepper grinders are just for pepper? Try filling one with M&M's and grinding them over your favorite dessert for a fun chocolate topping! Just make sure your grinder can handle them.

item.title: You Can Remove Your Dishwasher's Spray Arms?!
item.description: Did you know many dishwashers have removable spinning spray arms? Taking them out to clean clogged holes and trapped debris can help your dishwasher clean dishes more effectively!
